description: This file defines the CommandsController class, which handles API endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, deleting, and processing command-related data, including file uploads and job queue interactions.

classes.name: CommandProcessorJob
classes.description: Data structure representing a job to process a command, including usage ID, project ID, user ID, and file path.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new command.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing command by ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a paginated list of commands.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific command by ID.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete a command by ID, with audit logging.

methods.name: GetOutputParsers
methods.description: Returns available output parsers discovered by ProcessorIntegrationDiscovery.

methods.name: UploadOutput
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload output files, store attachments, and enqueue processing jobs.
